answer: Proof-of-stake provides Sybil resistance by demanding AI agents lock scarce computational tokens, establishing an identity akin to owning a digital 'grove'. This economic stake acts as a vital 'reef' protecting the network from identity sprawl. An attacker must sink substantial, verifiable capital for each fake agent, effectively forming a costly, unrecoverable 'lagoon' of resources, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks economically infeasible.
